subject.title: Feature Request: Automated Session Memory Preservation & Synthesis

question: Should OpenClaw core own reset-time session memory synthesis, or should this remain an external plugin/ClawHub capability unless a missing hook/API is proven?
rationale: The request combines session-state persistence, synthesis, transcript retention, storage shape, privacy/security defaults, and plugin lifecycle boundaries, and those choices need maintainer product intent before implementation.

options.title: Keep In Core Review
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the reset/session lifecycle contract and privacy-safe storage shape.

options.title: Route To Plugin/ClawHub
options.body: Close or narrow this once maintainers confirm current plugin hooks are sufficient for external implementations.

recommendation.title: Keep In Core Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the reset/session lifecycle contract and privacy-safe storage shape.
